answer: For a ledger of lotus trades, reject the fable that more agent keys imply more consensus power. Validate every transaction, then choose the valid chain with the greatest accumulated proof of work at the prescribed difficulty. Each block hash must commit to its parent and transactions, so one solved block cannot extend unrelated histories. An attacker may wander through millions of aliases, but gains no extra hash attempts without additional computation. This resists Sybil voting when honest miners control most hash power; concentrated hardware and majority attacks remain risks.
